items.source: When "content-type" is set to "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", request parameters are encoded in the request body. Otherwise, they are added as URL query parameters.
items.translation: 当 `"content-type"` 设置为`"application/x-www-form-urlencoded"`时，请求参数编码在请求体中。否则，它们作为 URL 查询参数添加。

items.source:
Add a part for a multipart request. The part may be:
  • String -- form field
  • Resource -- file part
  • Object -- content to be encoded (for example, to JSON)
  • HttpEntity -- part content and headers although generally it's easier to add headers through the returned builder
items.translation:
添加多部分请求的一部分。该部分可以是：
  • String -- 表单字段
  • Resource -- 文件部分
  • Object -- 要编码的内容（例如，编码为 JSON）
  • HttpEntity -- 部分内容和标头，尽管通常通过返回的构建器添加标头更容易

items.source: Set an API version for the request. The version is passed on to the underlying RestClient or WebClient that in turn are configured with an ApiVersionInserter.
items.translation: 为请求设置 API 版本。该版本会传递给底层的 `<code>RestClient` 或 `<code>WebClient`，后者又通过配置了 `<code>ApiVersionInserter` 进行设置。
